**M5 step-B (#576) sequencing and #570 execution-line cluster (issues 461-659 survey)**

**What**: Surveyed open issues #461,488,489,545,559,560,564,569,576,588,600,602,603,605,611,631,632,638,642,643,647,658,659 for labels/line/deps/size/human-only. Two structural findings worth remembering for future SDD ordering.

**Why**: Requested triage to plan work sequencing across M5/M8-adjacent and governance backlog.

**Where**:
- #576 (M5 step B, roles) — explicit chain: #312 (contract + ADR-0023 ratified) → #576 → then #323's map → #456's stage set. #576 in turn unblocks #575 (cold-review-as-SDD-stage executor) and #552 (inferential producer's output contract). At measurement time `brain/scripts/roles/` doesn't exist, `VALID_OPS=['init']` still literal, role port has n=0 inhabitants — nothing to project into yet, so #576 cannot lead until #312 lands.
- #600, #602, #603 all carry the same provenance line "derived from #570 / PR #596 — same execution line" — they're findings that fell out of #570's contributor-scaffold work but were outside its file claim, meant to be carried together by whoever picks up #570's thread, not independent tickets.
- #545 depends on #606 landing first (or basing its branch on #606) per maintainer comment, for the shared `{uncomputable, reason, detail}` shape in `uncomputable-cause.mjs`.

**Learned**: Several tickets in this batch had maintainer comments that materially corrected or amended the original body (#545's "refuse when >1 match" recommendation was measured and found it would have blocked 10/100 legitimate PRs — replaced with "verify all of them"; #560's Instance 2 was ruled GitHub-shaped-as-written and rewritten generic in a follow-up comment). Always read the last comments, not just the body, before treating an issue's proposed shape as final — the approved/needs-review label reflects the issue as amended, not as filed.
